scope: Text-only Yoga Ganster intake and canonical public dialogue; media NOT_IMPLEMENTED

configuration.YOGA_CHANNEL_ENABLED: false by default; root enables only after migration and reviewed identity gates
configuration.YOGA_SERVICE_API_TOKEN: Separate nonempty credential; must differ from SERVICE_API_TOKEN and ADMIN_API_TOKEN; never ship to browser
configuration.YOGA_OBSERVER_TELEGRAM_ID: Positive numeric Mikhail identity verified by primary; no username resolution or role grant
configuration.YOGA_MAIN_STAFF_CHAT_IDS: Server-only mirror of current main-bot all_staff_chat_ids, max100; not SUPPORT_CHAT_IDS or new global roles

authentication.yoga_principal: YOGA_SERVICE_API_TOKEN derives bot_key=yoga; inbound/client history/own delivery claim+settle
authentication.main_principal: SERVICE_API_TOKEN derives bot_key=safrway; own delivery claim+settle; main history/replies use existing staff ACL adapter
authentication.forbidden: Request-controlled bot_key, transport, role, recipients, source brand; /start attribution is not authentication

endpoints.requirements: Derive update_id and both IDs from actual Telegram update; private chat only (chat_id equals sender); body1..4000; bounded slug topic; extra fields forbidden
endpoints.idempotency: Same Yoga update ID + same exact body/sender/chat/topic/optional conversation repeats same canonical message; changed payload409; do not generate a new update ID on HTTP retry

endpoints.additional_header: X-Yoga-Sender-Id: actual Telegram sender numeric ID; never /start or arbitrary callback attribution
endpoints.access: Immutable binding sender must match; unknown/wrong sender/main-brand conversation404; main principal403; public messages only, at most200, no internal notes/route_context/other-client identity

endpoints.requirements: limit1..50; production workers claim1 to fit the60-second lease; bot transport bound to credential, never supplied in JSON; send exactly this message_id/body to this recipient only; use plain text or HTML-escape body and labels

roles.staff: SAFRWAY transport, existing staff controls only after existing staff ACL
roles.observer: Yoga transport to configured Mikhail OR SAFRWAY transport to existing SUPPORT recipient excluding staff; public dialogue read-only, NO reply/history/internal-note controls
roles.client: Yoga transport, canonical staff public reply to immutable original source chat; no staff controls

endpoints.lease: 60 seconds; no second claim while leased; expired lease UNKNOWN; never resend UNKNOWN automatically

outcomes.DELIVERED: Only after Telegram returned positive message_id
outcomes.RETRY: Only proven no-send errors connection_failed_before_send/transport_unavailable_before_send/rate_limited_before_send; max5 attempts bounded backoff
outcomes.UNKNOWN: Ambiguous timeout/connection loss after send may have begun => send_outcome_unknown; human review only

endpoints.retry_rules: HTTP settlement retry reuses exact lease+outcome; never send Telegram again to recover a lost ACK. Attempt5 pre-send RETRY settles FAILED. Stale token409; foreign transport404

errors.404: Conversation/delivery not visible to this principal/sender
errors.409: Idempotency, immutable source, lease or settlement conflict

integration_functions.bind_and_fanout: Existing canonical conversation+client message, trusted website brand resolver, server topic/policy; no second message or legacy WebOutboxEvent
integration_functions.intake_append: Bot ingress receipt and same WebConversation/WebMessage; existing User linked if present, never create user/lead/order/referral
integration_functions.queue_staff_reply: Only after existing main staff ACL creates public staff WebMessage; queue original Yoga source chat plus public-answer copies to configured Mikhail and existing SUPPORT observers; internal notes never enter this ledger; anonymous website remains canonical web reply only
integration_functions.serialize: Internal main adapter may call after its existing staff ACL; external Yoga GET additionally binds sender
integration_functions.transaction: Service functions flush, never commit; callers commit canonical message, receipt and all recipient deliveries atomically

topic_display: Server labels from the existing Registry and current approved metadata/legacy page. Yoga Ganster · question/service replaces the old section marker. RU/EN legacy page routes resolve the same existing Registry contentId even when publicBuild has no model. Unknown/corrupt topics fall back to Общий вопрос; never reflect arbitrary slug into a marker.
privacy: Private transport IDs only in binding/delivery, authenticated request headers/body and minimal delivery response; never route_context, analytics, public response, log text or audit packets
